title: Shopping
intro: Shopping ranked #1 trip interest. Budget ~$4,000–6,800 for shopping ($13–15K remaining for flights, hotels, food, activities). Splurge in Vietnam. Categories: tailored clothing, silk, artisan crafts, China-exclusive sneakers. Skip authorized luxury watches/handbags — no price advantage vs US.

tables.caption: Country Shopping Strength Matrix
rows: None — buy at home or Hong Kong

tables.caption: Shopping Priority Matrix
rows: Custom tailoring (suits, shirts, dresses, ao dai)

bullets.heading: Hội An — What to Order
items: ✅ Linen shirts (2–3 each; ~$40–80); silk blouse or dress (~$80–150)
✅ Lightweight wool-linen suit (~$200–350); ao dai (~$80–200)
❌ Avoid heavy wool suits (Vietnam can't source premium wool reliably)
❌ Avoid designer replicas (inconsistent quality; legal risk at US customs)

bullets.heading: Tailor Red Flags
items: Pushes same-day decision without measuring — reseller, not real tailor
No fitting offered — no quality control
Price drops dramatically when pushed back — inflated 300%+
Commission scam: "My cousin owns the fabric store"
For garments over $100: insist on 2 fittings minimum

bullets.heading: Recommended Shopping Days
items: Beijing Day 4 (primary): AM Wangfujing + Qianmen; PM Sanlitun Taikoo Li — ¥2,000–6,000 (~$280–840)
Hanoi Day 7: AM Hang Gai silk; PM Dong Xuan Market coffee/spices — ₫500,000–2,000,000 (~$20–80)
Hội An Day 10: Tailor consultation + Ancient Town browsing — $500–1,500 (excl. deposit)
Hội An Day 12: Tailor pickup + final Ancient Town pass
Đà Nẵng Day 13: Vincom Plaza; Non Nước marble carvings — $100–300

bullets.heading: Luggage & Shipping Logic
items: Buy bulky/fragile items in Vietnam (last stop) — tailored clothing, marble, lacquerware
DHL Vietnam: 5–7 days to US, ~$40–80 for 5kg; tailor vacuum-pack for carry-on when possible
Skip Beijing tailoring entirely — save all custom clothing budget for Hội An

bullets.heading: Safe Zones vs Counterfeit Districts
items: ✅ Beijing: SKP Mall, Shin Kong Place, Sanlitun Taikoo Li, brand flagships
❌ Beijing: Silk Street (Xiushui), Yaxiu Market — counterfeit capital
✅ Hanoi: Hang Gai silk shops; Dong Xuan Market for local goods
✅ Hội An: Yaly, A Dong, shops with street presence and reviews

callouts.text: Tailoring timeline validated: Day 10 consult → Day 11 fitting → Day 12 pickup
Shopping days on non-transit days (Days 4, 10, 12, 13); September 2 not a Chinese holiday
Counterfeit handbags ILLEGAL to import to US — confiscation + fines up to $10,000
Register valuables leaving US on CBP Form 4457 — prevents double-tax on re-entry
Best handbag purchase: hand-embroidered silk clutch or lacquerware purse from Hội An (~$20–100)
